title: Strictly graded commutative divided-power differential graded algebras
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. A divided-power differential graded $R$-algebra is a nonnegatively graded unital $R$-algebra $A=\bigoplus_{i\geq0}A_i$, as in [def-sfb-nonnegative-strict-graded-algebra], with $A_i=0$ for $i<0$, satisfying $xy=(-1)^{ij}yx$ for homogeneous $x\in A_i,y\in A_j$ and $x^2=0$ for odd-degree homogeneous $x$, together with an $R$-linear differential $d:A_i\to A_{i-1}$ such that $d^2=0$, $d(xy)=d(x)y+(-1)^i x d(y)$, and a graded divided-power structure [def-sfb-graded-divided-power-structure], written $\gamma_n$, on $A_{\mathrm{even},+}=\bigoplus_{i>0}A_{2i}$. Here $\gamma_0(x)=1$, $\gamma_1(x)=x$, $\gamma_n(x)\in A_{2in}$ for $x\in A_{2i}$, and the axioms are $\gamma_n(x)\gamma_m(x)=\binom{n+m}{n}\gamma_{n+m}(x)$, $\gamma_n(ax)=a^n\gamma_n(x)$ for $a\in A_{\mathrm{even}}$, $\gamma_n(x+y)=\sum_{b=0}^n\gamma_b(x)\gamma_{n-b}(y)$, $\gamma_n(\gamma_m(x))=\frac{(nm)!}{n!(m!)^n}\gamma_{nm}(x)$ for $n,m>0$, and $\gamma_n(uv)=0$ for homogeneous odd-degree $u,v$ and $n>1$. In these formulas $x,y$ belong to $A_{\mathrm{even},+}$, and the factorial quotient is an integer, acting by repeated addition. Compatibility means $d(\gamma_n(x))=d(x)\gamma_{n-1}(x)$ for $n\geq1$. Homology means $H_i(A)=\ker(d:A_i\to A_{i-1})/\operatorname{im}(d:A_{i+1}\to A_i)$. The underlying graded divided-power algebra is called polynomial if it is isomorphic, as a graded $R$-algebra with divided powers, to an algebra obtained from a polynomial $R$-algebra [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] in degree zero (whose positive even part is zero, with the trivial divided powers) by a finite or infinite sequence of successive adjunctions, each adjoining a set of exterior variables of one positive odd degree or of divided-power variables of one positive even degree, with the graded signs and the unique extended divided powers of [lem-sfb-divided-power-variable-adjunction]; for an infinite sequence the algebra is the union of the stages, as in that node. An even variable $T$ of degree $e$ has symbols $T^{[a]}$ of degree $ae$ for $a\geq0$, with $T^{[a]}=\gamma_a(T)$, $T^{[0]}=1$, $T^{[1]}=T$ and $T^{[a]}T^{[b]}=\binom{a+b}{a}T^{[a+b]}$; an odd variable has basis $1,T$ with $T^2=0$. The underlying chain complex and homology use [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology].

lean.note: The old IsPolynomial interface requires a DividedPowerDGA, hence a square-zero differential, and hides the generator labels in an existential. It cannot express the underlying polynomial algebra with specified generators before constructing an operator. All existing declarations are preserved. The additional GradedDividedPowers.PolynomialPresentation records the same arbitrary-degree set-adjunction tower, its actual degree-zero polynomial equivalence, extended divided powers and union, with bijective positive-generator labels and their images. It requires no differential and imposes no degree ordering.
